title: SIM Job Message
description: Triggers plagiarism detection for submissions of ONE language within an analysis batch. api splits by language before publishing — each language group becomes a separate message. SIM is stateless: all info provided in message, no DB access.

analysis_problem_id.description: PK of analysis_problems table — the batch being processed

language.description: Dolos language identifier for this group. All submissions in this message use this language.

language_group_index.description: 0-based index of this language group within the batch. Used by api for completion tracking.

language_group_total.description: Total number of language groups published for this analysis_problem. api waits for all groups before marking SIM completed.

submissions.description: All submissions to compare within this language group (from all sections in scope). Must have >= 2 for pairwise comparison. Groups with < 2 submissions are NOT published — api marks them not_applicable.

analysis_submission_id.description: PK of analysis_submissions table — for status tracking

file_url.description: MinIO pre-signed URL (TTL 6h) to download source code

trace_id.description: Cross-service tracing ID, generated by api
